items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: And after Mac died, I think, cause Roy, Roy, he, he started playing with him. Little Roy. He was a nice little drummer.

ctx.x: You heard you talk about Bob Lyon? Yeah. He was on bass. And had Rayd Happy on drums. I forgot Rayd Happy's, uh, right name. I think Bolton, wasn't it? Yeah, I think that his name is Bolton. After Bob. And they had him on drums. And later on, after, uh, Happy quit the band, I think he went in the show. And, uh, was a kid by the name of Mac. Oh yeah. And he died. And after Mac died, I think, cause Roy, Roy, he, he started playing with him. Little Roy. He was a nice little drummer. He died too. Well, he was quite,…
Well, do you remember, um, was Manuel Moneta with that band, Oliver, at the time you heard them?
